nflverse.notes: Attribute CC-BY data. Do not include FTN/CC-BY-SA-derived features in a proprietary app pending license review.

open_meteo.notes: Previous Runs API is on the free noncommercial tier and is CC BY 4.0. Commercial use needs a paid subscription. API Standard does not include Previous Runs.

noaa_cdo.license: NOAA Climate Data Online / public domain observations
noaa_cdo.notes: Free token required. Five requests per second and 10,000 requests per day. Daily station observations are not kickoff forecasts.

gdelt.notes: Article metadata only. Headlines are not verified injury reports. Confirm GDELT redistribution terms before a commercial product republishes articles.

nws.notes: Verify terms, rate limits, User-Agent, and location coverage.

nfl.target_share: prior mean of targets divided by team targets
nfl.carry_share: prior mean of carries divided by team carries
nfl.red_zone_targets: prior mean from player game stats
nfl.goal_line_carries: prior mean from player game stats
nfl.offensive_efficiency: prior team offensive EPA per play
nfl.defensive_efficiency: prior opponent defensive EPA per play
nfl.home_field: team is the home team; the box score has no team, so only a unique roster-week team that is in the game is used
nfl.pregame_weather: rejected: Open-Meteo issued_at is inferred as the valid hour minus 24 hours
nfl.availability: not used: box-score rows are players who played, so an out label cannot be scored
nfl.depth_chart: usage_pregame depth rank, starter flag, and roster status from an earlier chart
nfl.separation: prior-week NGS average separation, cushion, and yards after catch above expectation
nfl.rush_yards_over_expected: prior-week NGS rush yards over expected
nfl.formation: prior-game shotgun share and zone share

fbs.target_share: not separate from receptions; CFBD box sets targets equal to receptions on every row
fbs.carry_share: prior mean of carries divided by team carries
fbs.red_zone_targets: not in source; stored zeros are the column default
fbs.goal_line_carries: not in source; stored zeros are the column default
fbs.recent_workload: prior 3-game mean minus prior 10-game mean of the market count
fbs.offensive_efficiency: prior team offensive PPA stored in the EPA-named column
fbs.pregame_weather: rejected: no historical forecast has a source issue timestamp
fbs.availability: not used: one college injury row

excluded_everywhere: Open-Meteo previous-day values have no API issue timestamp; stored issued_at is inferred
NWS forecasts are live only and are not a historical backtest
NOAA daily observations are issued after the local observation day
GDELT headlines are not verified and are not linked to players
NGS week-zero totals are season aggregates
same-game EPA, snap counts, and target shares

baseline: M3 feature set re-fit before each test season: player shrinkage plus opponent adjustment
